passkeys.offerText: Set up a passkey: sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
passkeys.intro: With a passkey you sign in using your fingerprint, face or device PIN – no password or PIN to type. It is safer than a password, and your password manager can sync it to your other devices.
passkeys.sharedHint: Shared device (e.g. kitchen or bar tablet)? Then do not store a personal passkey here: anyone who can unlock the device could use it. Sign in with your PIN instead, or use the passkey on your own phone via QR code.
passkeys.sharedHintShort: Only set this up on your own device, not on a shared tablet.

tables.hint: Add or remove tables at any time, also during the event. A table with an open bill cannot be removed.

depositEnabled.label: Deposit
depositEnabled.hint: Item deposits are charged; waiters and the counter get the "Return deposit" button. Off: no deposit, even if items have a deposit value.

staffMealsEnabled.label: Helper / staff meals
staffMealsEnabled.hint: Waiters can book free orders for helpers (with a reason).

waiterCallsEnabled.label: Call the service
waiterCallsEnabled.hint: Guests can call the service to their table with a reason (pay, order, question). The table's waiter sees it first, after 2 minutes everyone in service; the bar screen shows every call. Off: the button is gone.

buzzer.hint1: A big button at the counter that works like a one-key keyboard (USB or Bluetooth). With a buzzer the kitchen and bar screen shows its lane: the oldest order, large, for the person at that buzzer. A press finishes it and the lane takes the next one. A second press within a second is ignored.
buzzer.hint2: For a second person behind the counter: a second lane next to the first. Each lane keeps its order until it is finished.
buzzer.sameKey: The other buzzer already uses this key.

foodPrepayEnabled.label: Pay for food when ordering
foodPrepayEnabled.hint: The kitchen only gets food once it is paid, so food runners can hand it out without cashing. Guests' food (QR code) waits until a waiter has cashed it; the table shows "Food to cash". Drinks are still paid when they are brought.
